item.title: Marketing Your App Idea: Cost Breakdown for Beginners
item.description: So, you want to create a dating app but have no coding experience? That can feel a bit daunting, but you’re not alone. Many people come up with amazing app ideas and wonder how to bring them to life. Your concept of a dating app that filters potential matches based on dietary preferences is unique and could resonate with a niche audience. Let’s break it down in terms of cost and process.
